text:
claire: Heads-up — a community model "Azurite-13B" was posted to HF and the infra team wants to experiment with quantized serving. I grabbed the repo: https://huggingface.co/azurite/azurite-13b. Noticed the license language is kinda fuzzy around commercial use. Can legal weigh in?

matt: paste the license snippet? happy to take a look.

claire: ```
License: Azurite-PL v1.0
Section 2.c: "No commercial use without express written permission from the authors."
End users may not redistribute model weights for commercial SaaS.
```

sophie: If that is restrictive we might only do internal POC / evals on Hosted dev env. What's the intended product use? customer-facing inferencing or just benchmarking?

claire: Initial plan is benchmarking + quant experiments to estimate throughput/cost vs Sapphire13B baseline. If evals are good we want to propose a pilot to one partner (could be commercial).

ramon: From infra side: model size ~13B unquant ~26GB FP16. 4-bit quant target brings memory down a lot but we need to confirm licensing for derivative weight generation (quantized weights are derivates?). Also need to check export controls for the weights.

matt: Quick legal read: "No commercial use" would block providing hosted inference or selling dedicated capacity that serves third-party customers. Internal benchmarking and research might be OK under "research exception" but that's not explicit. We need the model card + author contact.

claire: Added model card note: https://huggingface.co/azurite/azurite-13b#model-card

eval-bot: auto-eval finished: rouge/bleu/companion-bench against our internal prompts. Delta vs Sapphire13B: +0.4% accuracy (small), but hallucination rate up ~6%. Full report: https://redwood-internal/reports/azurite-2030012345

sophie: Hallucination up 6% is concerning. Can we run focused evals on our critical prompts? Also need license gating before any external pilot.

ramon: ops question — if legal allows internal use, do we need a data-leak / PII check before running evals on real customer prompts? we may use synthetic prompts first.

matt: yes to both. Steps I want: (1) confirm license owner contact and get written clarification on "commercial" scope; (2) export control scan (US EAR/ITAR check); (3) security review for possible data leakage; (4) record in model registry with license tags.

claire: Proposed bring-up checklist (quick):
- license_owner_contact: pending
- license_decision: pending
- export_control_clear: pending
- provenance_check (weights origin): done (HF repo claims original)
- quant_plan: 4-bit LLM.int8->QAT experiments scheduled
- eval_baseline_link: https://redwood-internal/reports/azurite-2030012345
- regression_thresholds: hallucination +3% triggers block
- owners: claire (lead), ramon (infra), matt (legal), sophie (product)

matt: +1. Also add: don't publish quantized weights outside Redwood until we get redistribution clearance. If the license forbids redistribution, our Dedicated offering cannot host for external customers.

ops-oncall: for infra: will we need KMS/HSM for customer keys if this becomes a pilot? if model is restricted, we may have to run in Private mode only.

claire: noted. I'll schedule an intake sync for tomorrow 11am PT. Agenda: quick legal check, export scan owner, eval scope, quant timeline.

sophie: tagging priority: P2 for now unless legal says it's permissive. :eyes:

ramon: I'll queue a smoke quant build on dev cluster (no external data) and share perf numbers by EOD.

matt: I'll reach out to the model authors and ask for a clarified license statement + permission form for commercial pilots. cc: @legal-team.

eval-bot: label applied: "onboarding:pending-legal"

claire: thanks all. If legal clears, next steps: run focused evals, run quantization bakeoff (QAT vs PTQ), and produce an OSS-risk summary.

ops-oncall: noted — will prepare KMS checklist and tenant isolation notes if we move to private hosting.

matt: quick FYI — export-control screening may take a few days if authors are in constrained geography. I'll flag timeline in the intake doc.

claire: thread pinned to the Azurite model intake folder and I'll drop minutes after the sync. :white_check_mark:
